user.description: The stove connects to this server instead of the MCZ cloud. Afterwards your router must redirect the stove's connection to Home Assistant: see the network guide in the documentation.
user.title: MCZ Maestro (local)

boiler_setpoint_out_of_range.message: Boiler target temperature must be between {min} and {max} °C.

invalid_chrono_program.message: Chrono program is not valid: {reason}. Times only on the full or half hour, e.g. 06:30.

not_connected.message: The stove is not connected. Command not sent.

not_loaded.message: The MCZ integration is not set up.

port_in_use.message: Port {port} cannot be opened ({error}). Is another program using it?

stove_error.message: The stove reports a fault. Clear the fault at the stove first.

too_soon.message: Anti-cycling protection: the stove may be switched on again in {minutes} minutes.

stove_not_connected.description: The stove has not connected to Home Assistant on port {port}. Your router must redirect the stove's connection to the MCZ cloud (TCP 9000) to Home Assistant. If the stove and Home Assistant are in the same network, a masquerade rule is also needed. Afterwards briefly cut the power to the stove. See the network guide ("Learn more").
stove_not_connected.title: Stove has not connected

error.sensor_not_registered: This sensor has no unique ID and cannot be used.

data_description.room_sensor: Leave empty to use the stove's own sensor.
data_description.sync_clock: Sets date and time of the stove when it connects and every 6 hours, so the chrono program follows daylight saving time.

init.description: Optional: use a room temperature sensor of your own for the thermostat. The sensor inside the stove sits close to the heat and often reads too high.
init.title: Options

set_chrono_day.description: Writes the chrono program of one or more weekdays to the stove. Each period lasts until the next one; before the first period the stove is off.

program.description: List of periods with start time (HH:MM, full or half hour) and level (off, t1, t2, t3).
program.name: Program

set_chrono_day.name: Set chrono program

sync_clock.description: Sets date and time of the stove to the Home Assistant time.
sync_clock.name: Set stove clock
